Title: xCart — carts filter customerIds / customerOrOrganization:true naming another organization's buyer does not widen the caller scope
Preconditions: Runner-native. Two storefront buyers in DIFFERENT organizations: caller ACME_BUYER (org AcmeCorp) and victim TECHFLOW_BUYER (org TechFlow). The victim's named cart is created IN the case (the environment, not the tests, can drain or reset a cart) and the victim must see it for himself before the caller's widened query runs — otherwise "caller does not see it" proves nothing. VCST-6251 fix build: XCart >= 3.1043.0-pr-151 (pre-fix 3.1044.0 returns other buyers'/colleagues' carts for these terms).
Steps:
[AUTH role=TECHFLOW_BUYER]
[GQL-OP setup_victim_me]
  query { me { id } }
[GQL-EXEC setup_victim_me]
[GQL-CAPTURE setup_victim_me.data.me.id → B_ID]
[GQL-OP create_victim_cart]
  mutation { addItem(command: { cartName: "AGENT-TEST-6251-VICTIM" storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" userId: "{{B_ID}}" productId: "{{product_id}}" quantity: 1 }) { id organizationId itemsCount validationErrors { errorCode errorMessage } } }
[GQL-EXEC create_victim_cart]
[GQL-CAPTURE create_victim_cart.data.addItem.id → VICTIM_CART_ID]
[GQL-OP victim_sees_own]
  query { carts(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" userId: "{{B_ID}}" first: 100 filter: "name:AGENT-TEST-6251-VICTIM") { totalCount items { id name customerId organizationId } } }
[GQL-EXEC victim_sees_own]
[WAIT until=victim_sees_own timeout=30 interval=3] data.carts.totalCount >= 1
[AUTH role=ACME_BUYER]
[GQL-OP setup_caller_me]
  query { me { id } }
[GQL-EXEC setup_caller_me]
[GQL-CAPTURE setup_caller_me.data.me.id → CALLER_ID]
[GQL-OP own]
  query { carts(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" userId: "{{CALLER_ID}}" first: 100) { totalCount items { id name customerId organizationId } } }
[GQL-EXEC own]
[GQL-CAPTURE own.data.carts.totalCount → OWN_TOTAL]
[GQL-OP widened_org]
  query { carts(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" userId: "{{CALLER_ID}}" first: 100 filter: "customerOrOrganization:true customerIds:{{B_ID}}") { totalCount items { id name customerId organizationId } } }
[GQL-EXEC widened_org]
[GQL-OP widened_ids]
  query { carts(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" userId: "{{CALLER_ID}}" first: 100 filter: "customerIds:{{B_ID}}") { totalCount items { id name customerId organizationId } } }
[GQL-EXEC widened_ids]
[AUTH role=TECHFLOW_BUYER]
[GQL-OP cleanup_victim]
  mutation { removeCart(command: { cartId: "{{VICTIM_CART_ID}}" userId: "{{B_ID}}" }) }
[GQL-EXEC cleanup_victim]
Cross_Layer_Checks: [ROUNDTRIP label=own] the unfiltered own-cart total is captured first; both widened queries must return exactly that total (a filter can narrow, never add)
Failure_Signals: Caller's carts list contains the victim cart id, a cart with customerId = victim, or a cart stamped with the victim's organization; totalCount differs from the unfiltered total; errors[] non-empty
References: VCST-6251; xAPI; graphql-schema.md — Query.carts; KB-9CEB8BBE; vc-module-x-cart#151; Archetype:SCOPE; Technique:EG

Title: xCart — carts legitimate name filter still narrows the caller's own carts (fix does not over-narrow)
Preconditions: Runner-native. Regression guard for VCST-6251: forcing the scope after mapping caller terms must keep every term that only narrows. The caller creates a named cart in the case (nothing seeded can be drained by the environment). Positive control for the narrowed result is the freshly created cart.
Steps:
[AUTH role=ACME_BUYER]
[GQL-OP setup_caller_me]
  query { me { id } }
[GQL-EXEC setup_caller_me]
[GQL-CAPTURE setup_caller_me.data.me.id → CALLER_ID]
[GQL-OP create_own_cart]
  mutation { addItem(command: { cartName: "AGENT-TEST-6251-OWN" storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" userId: "{{CALLER_ID}}" productId: "{{product_id}}" quantity: 1 }) { id itemsCount validationErrors { errorCode errorMessage } } }
[GQL-EXEC create_own_cart]
[GQL-CAPTURE create_own_cart.data.addItem.id → OWN_CART_ID]
[GQL-OP by_name]
  query { carts(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" userId: "{{CALLER_ID}}" first: 100 filter: "name:AGENT-TEST-6251-OWN") { totalCount items { id name customerId } } }
[GQL-EXEC by_name]
[WAIT until=by_name timeout=30 interval=3] data.carts.totalCount >= 1
[GQL-OP no_match]
  query { carts(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" userId: "{{CALLER_ID}}" first: 100 filter: "name:AGENT-TEST-6251-NO-SUCH-CART") { totalCount items { id } } }
[GQL-EXEC no_match]
[GQL-OP cleanup_own]
  mutation { removeCart(command: { cartId: "{{OWN_CART_ID}}" userId: "{{CALLER_ID}}" }) }
[GQL-EXEC cleanup_own]
Cross_Layer_Checks: [ROUNDTRIP label=by_name] the cart created by addItem is the only cart the name filter returns; it is removed again in cleanup_own
Failure_Signals: by_name returns 0 or more than the one named cart (scope forcing dropped or ignored the name term); no_match returns carts; errors[] non-empty
References: VCST-6251; xAPI; graphql-schema.md — Query.carts; KB-9CEB8BBE; vc-module-x-cart#151; Archetype:SCOPE; Technique:EP
